data.name: Dragon King's Impact
data.description: A Forbidden jutsu that uses the users own lifeforce to generate a high flying attack
data.battleDescription: %user uses a single hand to perform a series of simple hand seals before pressing the same hand on their blade. The blade shimmers briefly as %user jumps into the air, the chakra flowing around the weapon forms a dragon-shape around %user, the maw centered around the tip. With breathtaking speed, %user plummets towards %target, smashing the %weapon at them with devastating power, destroying everything at the impact zone.

data.name: Particle Cannon
data.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

data.name: Tempest Cleave
data.description: A slicing whirlwind cuts through multiple foes!
data.battleDescription: %user spins swiftly, their weapon or bare hands channeling gale-force winds. The air around them ignites into a slicing vortex, ripping through the battlefield. %target and surrounding enemies are caught in the tempest, battered by razor-sharp wind currents. The relentless storm fades with a final powerful slash, leaving devastation in its wake.

data.name: Decaying Touch
data.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

data.name: Chakra Resonance
data.description: A harmonic pulse that damages and stuns the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user emits a resonating wave of chakra that crashes into %target, disrupting their flow and leaving them stunned.

data.name: Danse Macabre
data.description: Summon spectral blades that target the opponents chakra points.
data.battleDescription: Spectral blades erupt from %user in a ghostly bloom, drifting like phantoms through the air. They scatter around %target before suddenly arcing inward with eerie grace, piercing chakra points and inhibiting the flow of chakra.

data.name: Netherblight
data.description: A corrupting curse that damages the enemy over time while steadily healing the user.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a lingering chakra curse that seeps into %target’s system. As the affliction eats away at them, dark energy flows back to the caster, gradually restoring their vitality with every passing second.

data.name: Atomic Shield
data.description: Create a barrier of particles to protect you
data.battleDescription: %user creates a translucent barrier made of the particles around them to defend from all attacks

data.name: Windshear Decay
data.description: Razor sharp wind slashes that leave lasting and decaying effects
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of intricate hand seals which summons forth the power of the winds that once quelled Fujin's fury. With a swift motion, they unleash a torrent of razor-sharp wind slashes that tear through the air towards %target. The wind howls with a vengeful fury, and as the invisible blades connect, they slice deep into %target's flesh, leaving behind festering wounds. The air around %target grows heavy with the scent of decay as the slashes begin to fester and deepen over time, continuing to tear at their flesh with each passing moment.

data.name: Drops of Renewal
data.description: Summons celestial dew to heal yourself
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands, invoking a soft, luminous chant. From above, ethereal droplets of dew descend, shimmering with celestial light. The dew gathers upon %user and their allies, mending wounds and revitalizing spirits. As the healing touch takes effect, a sense of tranquility washes over the battlefield, bolstering resilience against further harm.

data.name: Chakra Overflow
data.description: A potent chakra buff that enhances all offensive abilities and raises the user’s stats.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in waves—thick, radiant, and barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. Simultaneously, the user’s core stats spike, fueling their body and mind for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It’s the edge between control and chaos—a moment where the user becomes a living conduit of power.

data.name: Eternal Darkness
data.description: Blind your foe in a shroud of darkness decreasing the effectiveness of their damage
data.battleDescription: %user performs various hand scenes and a veil of darkness surrounds %target blocking their ability to see %user

data.name: Seal of Nullification
data.description: A sealing technique that suppresses buffs and enhancement abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, stripping away buffs and suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements.

data.name: Blazing Reprisal
data.description: A fiery barrier that  swarms the target absorbing there lifeforce while scorching them.
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a fiery barrier that absorbs a portion of %target’s health,  while searing them in immense heat

data.name: Seimyaku
data.description: A subtle pulse of chakra that suppresses enemy recovery while shielding the user from harm
data.battleDescription: %user emits a deep, controlled pulse of refined chakra that interferes with %target’s ability to recover while reinforcing their own defenses. The technique dampens restorative energies around the enemy and surrounds the user in a chakra field that cushions incoming attacks.
